# envoy-smoke's fetch (.github/workflows/ci-job-envoy-smoke.yaml): the modules of the container smoke
# test (smoke-tagged internal/smoke, and the cgo-less systemroots probe it builds), the envoy-infra
# plugin its fetch step, its live tests (pulumitest.Plugin) and its schema step build, and the live
# tests of host. The SDK consumer's own modules are that step's `go-fetch.sh pulumi-consumer`.
deps packages/envoy -test -tags smoke ./internal/smoke/
CGO_ENABLED=0 deps packages/envoy ./internal/smoke/systemroots
deps packages/envoy/infra ./cmd/pulumi-resource-envoy-infra
deps packages/envoy/infra -test -tags pulumilive ./host/
